summary: Gerdau S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing two capital-return actions approved by its Board of Directors. First, it declared an interim dividend of R$0.23 per common and preferred share (plus R$0.11 for Metalúrgica Gerdau) as an advance on the fiscal 2026 minimum dividend, with record dates in August 2026 and payment in September 2026. Second, it approved cancellation of 163,100 common and 6,975,000 preferred treasury shares, with no capital reduction, reducing outstanding shares to approximately 716.98M common and 1.26B preferred. The existing share buyback program remains in effect. No premium, price, or advisors are involved. Watch for further buyback activity or capital-return announcements.
